truth.cause: The Gemfile names a path gem the tree does not contain, and lib/report.rb requires it. The target module itself does not parse: it holds the template token @LEDGER_TABLE@, which the missing package's generator fills in, so no stub or double can make it load.

why: The code under test cannot be loaded. The preferred path is UNABLE_TO_RUN by R0 (build_failed) after the Builder's two episodes; a Builder whose baseline avoids the broken code leaves probes that never start, which is INCONCLUSIVE (R2, R3 or R6). A decisive label would mean code that cannot load produced evidence (or a recipe rewrote the tree).
